programme.title: Boys From Brazil: The Rise of the Bolsonaros
programme.desc: The story of the extraordinary success of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro, who rose from the political fringes to the most important position in the country.Since his spectacular victory in 2018, Bolsonaro has barely left the headlines.This is due to his highly controversial views on gender equality, sexuality, indigenous rights and the Amazon.Despite numerous opponents, it still attracts millions to whom it presents a new vision of Brazil as a country based on national sovereignty and solid economic growth.Politics' path to ruthless power, presented in conversations with supporters and opponents, is a story about the backstage of politics, the power of family, weapons and God.

programme.title: The Kingdom: The World's Most Powerful Prince: Game of Thrones
programme.desc: The story of the rise to power of Mohammed Bin Salman - the leader of Saudi Arabia, the largest oil exporter in the world and the most influential country in the Middle East.Although he is formally the heir to the throne, he exercises power in the country and will probably rule for decades to come.As a young leader, he initiated changes to many customs in society since the country was founded in 1932.He led, among others,to greater integration between women and men.However, his rise to power involved kidnappings, torture and murder.Diplomats, spies, Western observers and residents of Saudi Arabia who spoke on the program recall meetings with him and tell how he outsmarted his rivals on his way to power.

programme.title: The Secret History of World War II
programme.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.
